vm: LinuxKit 7.0.12, arm64, 10 vCPUs, nominal 4 GiB RAM plus 1 GiB swap
postgres: 18.6, shared_buffers=256MB, enable_memoize=off, jit=off, max_connections=600; default durability enabled
notes: Single local run per comparator; not a maximum-capacity search or official ranking.
CPU per request uses cgroup counters interpolated at load timeline boundaries during the steady hold.
Reported p95/p99 include ramp and hold. Memory columns are sampled anonymous cgroup memory, excluding kernel sockets and file-backed pages.
C# epoll struct uses ARM64 Pack=8; libdeflate 1.23-2 is installed.
F# uses ARM64 runtime assets, libdeflate arm/cpu_features.c and SLOTS=131072 per loop.
Java uses Xms128m and Xmx512m to fit the VM, retaining the other original JVM flags.
Temporary lab limits: fs.file-max 400317 -> 1200000, nf_conntrack_max 65536 -> 1048576. These are not set by the submitted server.
Initial conntrack-limited 200K run and 8-IP 300K run (peak 233419) were rejected; they are not included in this comparison.
The 300K run used 16 destination IPs on both ports and experienced host swap/I/O pressure.
The final client corrects progress-line rates for delayed timer ticks; workload, totals and histograms are unchanged.
